text:
Both summaries are accurate. Each gets the three-day rule, the formal-versus-informal exception, the excluded Claims and Customer Contact teams, the equipment funding change, the Levels 3 and 4 hot desking, and the rationale right, with no dates or conditions misstated. Response A adds that team leaders set the common day and that the Q&A is on the intranet, which are useful but minor. Response B omits those details but keeps every point a busy manager needs.

The length limit matters here. Response A runs to roughly 155 words, well over the 120-word cap. Response B is roughly 125 words, at or very slightly over the limit, and is tighter. Since the extra words in A don't add anything the manager critically needs, B is the better response.

Verdict: B
